topic.JOZEF.ambient 2.002: We’ll find out before the bus comes.
topic.JOZEF.ambient 2.x01: I know the bus. At least it runs to a timetable that’s printed.
topic.JOZEF.ambient 2.x03: Then I wait by the noticeboard. Here at least someone tells me why it’s late.
topic.JOZEF.extra 1.label: That magnifying glass
topic.JOZEF.extra 1.001: Do you take that magnifying glass everywhere?
topic.JOZEF.extra 1.002: Everywhere, young man. A folding one, from my father. He read with it, and now I do.
topic.JOZEF.extra 1.003: And what do you read with it most?
topic.JOZEF.extra 1.004: The noticeboard, the paper and guarantees. Guarantees especially – that’s where the print is smallest.
topic.JOZEF.extra 2.label: Čierna Voda in the old days
topic.JOZEF.extra 2.001: What was it like here when you were younger?
topic.JOZEF.extra 2.002: A field, a few weekend cottages and water. Now there are streets named after that field.
topic.JOZEF.extra 2.004: I do. I’d just like someone to print a map as well. On paper, young man.
topic.JOZEF.extra 3.label: The bus into town
topic.JOZEF.extra 3.001: What’s the best way to get to Dúbravka from here?
topic.JOZEF.extra 3.002: Bus from this stop into town, and change there. Don’t forget your mask – the driver’s stricter than I am.
topic.JOZEF.extra 3.004: All I ask for is large print. Without a mask, he won’t even let you on the first step.
topic.LENKA.ambient 1.label: Bodka’s name
topic.LENKA.ambient 1.001: Why is he actually called Bodka?
topic.LENKA.ambient 1.002: Because when I say ‘that’s enough, full stop’, he always has one more woof to add. Bodka means full stop.
topic.LENKA.ambient 1.003: Bodka, anything else you’d like to add?
topic.LENKA.ambient 2.label: Does Bodka mind the pandemic?
topic.LENKA.ambient 2.001: Not at all. He thinks the whole world has finally discovered walks.
topic.LENKA.ambient 2.002: And is he right? Do you go out more now?
topic.LENKA.ambient 2.x01: Four times a day. It used to be twice, and even that took some negotiating.
topic.LENKA.ambient 2.x03: He did. Whoever’s standing by the door always wins.
topic.LENKA.extra 1.label: Walks
topic.LENKA.extra 1.001: Where do you and Bodka go for walks?
topic.LENKA.extra 1.002: To the pond. Well, he goes to the pond and I follow him.
topic.LENKA.extra 1.003: And when you want to go somewhere else?
topic.LENKA.extra 1.004: Then we go to the pond a different way.
topic.LENKA.extra 2.label: Neighbours
topic.LENKA.extra 2.001: How do you like living here?
topic.LENKA.extra 2.002: I like it. People here know each other by their dogs. They call me Bodka’s lady.
topic.LENKA.extra 2.003: And what do they call me?
topic.LENKA.extra 2.004: Mrs Hrušková’s grandson. You haven’t got a dog, so you’re your gran’s.
topic.LENKA.extra 3.label: When it rains
topic.LENKA.extra 3.001: What does Bodka do when it rains?
topic.LENKA.extra 3.002: He stands by the door looking as if I ordered the rain.
topic.LENKA.extra 3.004: No. But I apologise to him every time.
topic.MIRA20.ambient 1.label: How are you?
topic.MIRA20.ambient 1.002: I’m at home, I’ve got everything and we talk on the phone. Don’t turn me into another item on a list.
topic.MIRA20.ambient 1.003: Fine. Then at least you’ll be first on the list.
topic.MIRA20.ambient 1.x01: I’m first on Ela’s list anyway. I checked.
topic.MIRA20.ambient 1.x02: Gran, you check up on Ela too?
topic.MIRA20.ambient 1.x03: I check up on everyone who checks up on me. That’s only fair.
topic.MIRA20.ambient 2.label: Why did you keep all those things?
topic.MIRA20.ambient 2.001: A repaired thing shows you where it broke. A new one won’t tell you that.
topic.MIRA20.ambient 2.x01: And the three skis in the workshop?
topic.MIRA20.ambient 2.x02: That’s two skis and a spare part. Over the years it’s come in handy once already.
topic.MIRA20.after.label: After you came back
topic.MIRA20.after.001: Gran, do you know what happened?
topic.MIRA20.after.002: I know you came back. You can tell me the rest when it’s possible to visit.
topic.MIRA20.after.003: It’ll take a long time to tell.
topic.MIRA20.after.004: That’s why I have a big teapot.
topic.MIRA20.after.x01: I’ll start with Ivanka. You were twenty-two and very strict with me.
topic.MIRA20.after.x02: I was strict with anyone who spoke imprecisely. And you kept mentioning the strangest years.
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.label: Soldering
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.001: Do you remember teaching me to solder?
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.002: I do. You were seven and you wanted to solder everything, even a teaspoon.
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.003: In the end I didn’t solder the teaspoon.
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.004: Because I hid it from you. I hid the soldering iron too, but you found that.
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.005: And how quickly did I find it?
topic.MIRA20.extra 1.006: In two days. You searched systematically, drawer by drawer. That’s when I knew you’d be a repairer.
topic.MIRA20.extra 2.label: Phone calls
topic.MIRA20.extra 2.001: Who have you been on the phone to today?
topic.MIRA20.extra 2.002: Dana, Ela, Roman and the neighbour who couldn’t switch her radio on.
topic.MIRA20.extra 2.003: And did she switch it on?
topic.MIRA20.extra 2.004: She did. Now she doesn’t know how to switch it off. She’ll ring me about that tomorrow.
topic.MIRA20.extra 3.label: Oto
topic.MIRA20.extra 3.001: What was Oto like when you worked together?
topic.MIRA20.extra 3.002: Precise. I was twenty-two and thought I knew everything. Oto corrected me every day.
topic.MIRA20.extra 3.004: Worse. He was right. You can’t have a proper argument with someone like that.
topic.ROMAN.ambient 1.label: How are the deliveries going?
topic.ROMAN.ambient 1.002: Two of them were described to me today as ‘the house that used to be yellow’.
topic.ROMAN.ambient 1.x01: The green one. They repainted it in July, but to the village it’ll stay yellow for another ten years.
topic.ROMAN.ambient 1.x03: The same house. Two families live in it, and both forgot it’s green now.
topic.ROMAN.ambient 2.label: Parcels on the doorstep
topic.ROMAN.ambient 2.001: So now you just ring the bell and run?
topic.ROMAN.ambient 2.002: Exactly. And people thank me and wave through the windows. Strange, but nice.
topic.ROMAN.ambient 2.x02: Before, they didn’t even open the door. Now at least they open the windows.
topic.ROMAN.ambient 2.x03: One lady even waved a cake at me. Behind the glass, but it still counts.
topic.ROMAN.extra 1.label: Gran’s boxes
topic.ROMAN.extra 1.001: Gran says you carried some boxes for her.
topic.ROMAN.extra 1.002: I did. One was the heaviest thing all month. And this month I delivered a washing machine.
topic.ROMAN.extra 1.004: I don’t look in other people’s boxes. But something in it jingled with every step.
topic.ROMAN.extra 1.006: Like when something jingles in your car and you don’t know whether to do anything about it.
topic.ROMAN.extra 2.label: The route
topic.ROMAN.extra 2.002: Grob, Čierna Voda and a bit of the next village.
topic.ROMAN.extra 2.003: And are the addresses normal in Čierna Voda?
topic.ROMAN.extra 2.004: There they’ve got new streets with old names. The satnav sends me into a field.
topic.ROMAN.extra 2.005: So who points you the right way in the end?
topic.ROMAN.extra 2.006: Mr Jozef by the noticeboard. He knows who lives where, without any house numbers.
topic.TONO20.ambient 1.label: That birdhouse?
topic.TONO20.ambient 1.001: Alongside the maintenance, I make birdhouses for the children. When they come back, at least there’ll be something new waiting for them.
topic.TONO20.ambient 1.002: So the school hasn’t stopped completely.
topic.TONO20.ambient 1.x02: Seven. Only one is occupied so far. A blue tit didn’t read the notice about the school being closed.
topic.TONO20.ambient 2.label: The school is so quiet
topic.TONO20.ambient 2.001: It has to be, for now. But it won’t be empty for ever.
topic.TONO20.ambient 2.002: Now you can even hear your own footsteps here.
topic.TONO20.ambient 2.x01: And every door. At last I know which ones need oiling.
topic.TONO20.ambient 2.x02: And which ones creak the most?
topic.TONO20.ambient 2.x03: The prep room door. It was already creaking when I went to school here.
topic.TONO20.extra 1.001: How many keys are on that bunch?
topic.TONO20.extra 1.002: Forty-two. One for every door, and one that doesn’t open anything any more.
topic.TONO20.extra 1.003: And what was the last one for?
topic.TONO20.extra 1.004: The old boiler room. They knocked the boiler room down; the key stayed. I’ve got used to its weight.
topic.TONO20.extra 2.label: Children at the window
topic.TONO20.extra 2.001: Do children still come here now?
topic.TONO20.extra 2.002: With their parents, to collect equipment. Through the window they show me what they’ve done in remote lessons.
topic.TONO20.extra 2.003: And what do they show you?
topic.TONO20.extra 2.004: Mostly drawings. One once showed me a cat. Apparently that’s homework too.
topic.TONO20.extra 3.label: The metal swallow
topic.TONO20.extra 3.001: Did you make that metal swallow yourself?
topic.TONO20.extra 3.002: From sheet metal, back when I was an apprentice. I’ve got a wooden one at home on a shelf.
topic.TONO20.extra 3.004: Because it comes back to the same place. At twelve, that seemed like a good plan to me.
item.PHONE: The battery’s charged. Outside 2020, all I have left on the phone is the camera and my notes. I’m not expecting a signal.
item.PHONE.purpose: Take photos and notes. Later, photograph the panel in 2035.
item.TOOLS: Screwdriver, pliers and a multimeter. Tools don’t get used up – that’s the best thing about them.
item.TOOLS.purpose: Repair devices, for example the scales or the clamp.
item.ORDER: Tea, potatoes and oats, in Gran’s handwriting. Dana has the bag ready.
item.GROCERIES: A closed bag for Gran. I’m carrying it by both handles.
item.GROCERIES.purpose: Leave it on the little table outside Mira’s garden gate.
item.SHEDKEY: The brass key to Gran’s workshop. The key ring has a WORKSHOP tag, in case I forget.
item.CHRONO: A brass device with four little lights and the club’s emblem. Its protective field protects me and everything I carry.
item.CHRONO.purpose: Travel in time, show it to experts and take measurements by Vrbické pleso.
item.FUSE_OLD: Blown, but the rating is still readable. It belongs in the e-waste, not back in the device.
item.FUSE_OLD.purpose: Use it to find an identical replacement.
item.FUSE: The same rating and type as the blown one. Exactly what the base node needs.
item.FUSE.purpose: Put it into the cradle of the ZVON base node.
item.PHOTO2020: The yard in 2020: a tarmac corner with no lime tree and the service window with the metal swallow. Tóno will recognise that swallow.
item.PHOTO2020.purpose: Convince Tóno in 1982 and compare how the yard has changed.
item.SCHOOLPASS: A permit from the school: I may enter the lobby and the physics prep room. The other classrooms are closed.
item.SCHOOLPASS.purpose: Access to the school lobby and prep room in 2020.
item.LOG1982: 7 December 1982: Oto’s drawing of a ceramic bridge with three leads. His grandson Tóno helped. The bridge was lost.
item.LOG1982.purpose: Open the time window to 1982 at the old clock frame at the stop.
item.SEALED_OLD: Dust on the outside, dry paper inside. The seal has held for thirty-eight years.
item.SEALED_OLD.purpose: Open it with tools and check the bridge’s contacts.
item.RETURNBRIDGE: The ceramic is intact, the contacts are clean, and Tóno’s swallow is on the label. The very piece I hid in 1982.
item.RETURNBRIDGE.purpose: Keep it on me for a safe intervention and return.
item.HANDOVER: A record from Ela: who handed over box Z-17, who collected it, and the owner’s consent. The signatures are missing.
item.HANDOVER.purpose: Collect Roman’s and Ela’s signatures for moving the box in 2020.
item.HANDOVER_R: Roman’s signature is there: he collected the box and took it to Gran’s workshop.
item.HANDOVER_R.purpose: Give it to Ela so she can confirm the handover.
item.CHAIN: Box Z-17: the pick-up point, Roman, the workshop. Gran gave her consent in a recorded call; nobody had to enter the house.
item.CHAIN.purpose: Proof of consent. It also opens the way to 2035.
item.BALL: A chewed red ball. Bodka clearly loves it with every one of his teeth.
item.BALL.purpose: Give it back to Lenka and Bodka.
item.FLYER: NEIGHBOURHOOD HELP 9–17 and Ela’s number below it, all in large print. You can read it without a magnifying glass.
item.FLYER.purpose: Pin it to the community noticeboard.
quest.M01.goal: Help Mira with her shopping and get into her garden workshop.
quest.M01.hint.1: Start at the pick-up point at Lúčny koník.
quest.M01.hint.2: Ela gives you the shopping list, and Dana gives you the bag for it. Leave the bag on the little table outside the gate, then ring Mira below her window.
quest.M01.hint.3: Tool bag in the garage → Ela: topic ‘Gran’s shopping’ → shopping list on Dana → bag of shopping on the table outside the gate → below the closed window, Mira: topic ‘Anything else you need?’
quest.M02.goal: Find out why the unplugged ZVON in the garden workshop keeps making sounds, and get it working.
quest.M02.hint.1: The device in the workshop isn’t working because of one ordinary fault.
quest.M02.hint.2: Unlock the workshop with the key and take the chronometer from the case. Open the service cover with the tool bag; you have the same fuse in your garage.
quest.M02.hint.3: Key on the workshop door → chronometer from the brass case → tool bag on the base node’s cradle → fuse from the drawer in the garage → put it in the cradle → on the shape panel, connect matching shapes.
quest.M11A.goal: Find out from Mira what else a safe return needs, and look for it in Dúbravka in 2020.
quest.M11A.hint.1: Mira sends you to fifty-year-old Tóno, the caretaker at Sokolíkova. A bus to Dúbravka leaves from the stop in Čierna Voda.
quest.M11A.hint.2: First photograph the school yard in 2020 from the pavement. Then show the chronometer to Tóno at the old service window.
quest.M11A.hint.3: Show Mira the verified imprint from 1962 → phone on the corner of the yard with the service window → chronometer on Tóno at the service window → 1982 service logbook in the physics prep room → copy of the service record on the frame of the old clock at the Dúbravka stop.
quest.M11D.goal: Help Ela record the real move of Mira’s box, and open the way to Jasná 2035.
quest.M11D.hint.1: Once you have the bridge, go back to the volunteers in Grob.
quest.M11D.hint.2: Ela gives you the original handover record. Roman, in the lane, signs for the collection; then Ela signs for the handover.
quest.M11D.hint.3: Ela: topic ‘A form for Gran’s box’ → handover record on Roman → record signed by Roman on Ela → confirmed handover 2020 on the ZVON base node; the bridge must be in your bag.
quest.Q1.goal: Find Bodka’s ball and give it back to Lenka.
quest.Q1.hint.1: Lenka and her dog are in the lane between the fences, by the van.
quest.Q1.hint.2: The ball stayed on the dry side of the railing by the retention pond in Čierna Voda.
quest.Q1.hint.3: Lenka in the lane between the fences: topic ‘What’s up with Bodka?’ → red ball by the retention pond → Bodka’s ball on Lenka.
quest.Q1.reward: A photo of Bodka in Adam’s album.
quest.Q2.goal: Put up a notice on the noticeboard in Čierna Voda that even Mr Jozef can read.
quest.Q2.hint.1: Mr Jozef, by the noticeboard in Čierna Voda, can’t read the neighbourhood help hours.
quest.Q2.hint.2: Ela at the pick-up point can print the same notice in large print.
quest.Q2.hint.3: Mr Jozef by the noticeboard: topic ‘Help with the notice?’ → Ela at the pick-up point: topic ‘Got a notice in large print?’ → large notice on the noticeboard.
quest.Q2.reward: A copy of the large notice and Jozef’s thanks in the album.
puzzle.P01.clue: Connect matching shapes. The colours don’t matter.
puzzle.P01.title: Three Reference Shapes
puzzle.P01.wrong: These shapes don’t belong together. The diagram above the panel connects like with like.
journal.clue.P01: three shapes match; colour doesn’t matter
puzzle.P05.clue: The sketch of the service cavity and Tóno’s note from 1995: second row from the top, third stone from the left. Next to them, the original photo of the yard.
puzzle.P05.success: The cavity is in the same place. It’s just that everything around it has grown.
puzzle.P05.title: The Cavity in the Same Low Wall
puzzle.P05.wrong: That’s a solid brick; I’m not prising that out. According to the note, it’s row two, column three.
